description:
Delete a source from the current NotebookLM notebook.

You can identify the source to delete by either:
- source_id: The unique identifier of the source
- source_name: The name/title of the source (partial match supported)

Use list_content first to see available sources and their IDs/names.

WARNING: This action is irreversible. The source will be permanently removed from the notebook.

notebook_url.description: Notebook URL. If not provided, uses the active notebook.

session_id.description: Session ID to reuse an existing session

source_id.description: The unique ID of the source to delete

source_name.description: The name/title of the source to delete (partial match supported)

name: source_delete

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
